name: rec-mode
description: Recording mode: blurs emails, keys, IP addresses and user names on screen; hover over a blurred spot to reveal it. /rec turns it on and off.

names.title: Extra names to blur
names.description: Comma-separated words to blur as well (a GitHub handle, a client's name). A word that starts with one is blurred too, so Marcin also covers Marcinowi.
